SELECT
  s.name AS supplier_name,
  s.lead_time_days AS lead_time_days_contracted,
  agg.pos_ordered,
  agg.pos_received,
  ROUND(agg.avg_actual_lead_days, 1) AS avg_actual_lead_days,
  ROUND(agg.pct_received_late, 1) AS pct_received_late,
  ROUND(agg.avg_days_late, 1) AS avg_days_late
FROM suppliers s
JOIN (
  SELECT
    po.supplier_id,
    COUNT(*) AS pos_ordered,
    COUNT(po.received_at) AS pos_received,
    AVG(CASE WHEN po.received_at IS NOT NULL THEN (po.received_at::date - po.ordered_at::date) END) AS avg_actual_lead_days,
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN po.expected_at IS NOT NULL AND po.received_at IS NOT NULL AND po.received_at > po.expected_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN po.expected_at IS NOT NULL AND po.received_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_received_late,
    AVG(CASE WHEN po.expected_at IS NOT NULL AND po.received_at IS NOT NULL AND po.received_at > po.expected_at
             THEN (po.received_at::date - po.expected_at::date) END) AS avg_days_late
  FROM purchase_orders po
  WHERE po.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND po.ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY po.supplier_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
) agg ON agg.supplier_id = s.id
ORDER BY agg.pos_ordered DESC, s.name ASC
LIMIT 50
note: pct_received_late and avg_days_late are computed only over POs that have both expected_at and received_at populated (per the request's definition); POs missing either timestamp are excluded from those two measures but still count toward pos_ordered/pos_received.
